messages.subject: updated signing keys for RKward debian repo
messages.subject_clean: updated signing keys for RKward debian repo
messages.body_plain:
hi,

since our current package signing key is about to expire soon, i've added a 
new key on the server (debR40 repo only), installable as a package called 
"rkward-keyring".

the package installs the key(s) to /usr/share/keyrings/rkward-keyring.gpg and 
no longer adds them to the global trust.db, so you can be sure it can only be 
used to verify our packages. you'll have to manually adjust your sources list 
file enable apt to find the right key:

deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/rkward-keyring.gpg] https://
distribute.kde.org/rkward/debR40 unstable main

older versions of the keyring package used the ASCI format (rkward-
keyring.asc), which is deprecated and was now also corrected.


viele grüße :: m.eik

-- 
  dipl. psych. meik michalke
  institut f"ur experimentelle psychologie
  abt. f"ur diagnostik und differentielle psychologie
  heinrich-heine-universit"at d-40204 d"usseldorf
